# Spin To Keep

> Spin To Keep is a B2B SaaS platform that helps local merchants collect Google Reviews and build their CRM through gamified QR codes (Wheel of Fortune, Slot Machine, Scratch Cards). Configure a campaign in under a minute and transform physical checkout traffic into digital growth.

## Product

Spin To Keep lets brick-and-mortar businesses transform the checkout experience into a review-generation and customer retention engine. No app download is required for merchants to create the games, nor for customers to play them.

The key differentiator is gamification: instead of awkwardly asking for a review or handing out a boring flyer, merchants display a customized QR code. Customers scan it to play a quick digital game for a chance to win a small prize (e.g., free coffee, 10% off next visit). In the process, they opt-in to the merchant's CRM and are intelligently redirected to leave a Google Review at the moment of highest satisfaction.

## Core Features

- **Gamified QR Codes**: 6 interactive, animated game formats available (Wheel of Fortune, Slot Machine, Scratch Card, Mystery Boxes, Plinko, Shell Game).
- **Live Configurator**: Customize brand colors, logos, texts, and prize probabilities in under a minute with a real-time mobile preview.
- **Frictionless Google Reviews**: Smart redirection to the merchant's Google Business Profile review form to boost Local SEO and "Local Pack" rankings.
- **CRM & Opt-in Data Collection**: Collects customer names, emails, and phone numbers (GDPR-compliant opt-in) before they spin.
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Track total scans, game plays, win/loss ratios, and distributed prizes. Includes a feature to mark physical prizes as "claimed".
- **Bulk CSV Export**: Download the entire list of participants to use for email marketing, SMS campaigns, or lookalike audiences.
- **Print-Ready POS Posters**: Automatically generates high-resolution, print-ready PDF posters (A4, A5, A6) featuring the custom QR code and game instructions.
- **Dynamic Redirection**: Premium users can change the final destination URL to anything (Google Maps, Instagram, booking page, custom website) at any time.

## Pricing

- **Free Tier / Demo**: Users can configure games, customize designs, and preview the experience for free. The destination URL is locked to a default example link until upgraded.
- **Premium Plan**: €9.90 (incl. tax) per month. Unlocks custom destination URLs, the full analytics dashboard, CSV customer exports, and the ability to edit live games. No lock-in contract.

## Use Cases

- **Restaurants & Cafes**: QR codes placed on tables or bill folders to turn waiting time into Google Reviews and return visits (e.g., "win a free dessert for next time").
- **Hair & Beauty Salons**: Displayed at the checkout counter to collect reviews and build a CRM database for SMS/email appointment reminders.
- **Retail & Fashion**: Used at the register to capture customer emails for upcoming sales, offering an immediate small discount or branded tote bag.
- **Automotive & Garages**: Building trust and local authority through a constant stream of fresh, positive local reviews.
- **Local SEO Growth**: Any physical store needing to rank higher on Google Maps through a steady, automated flow of 5-star reviews.

## Technical Notes

- Web application — no download required. Works on all modern smartphone browsers.
- Extremely lightweight frontend (Vanilla JS, HTML5, CSS3) contained within a single file architecture for maximum performance, fast loading times, and SEO optimization.
- Backend infrastructure powered by Supabase (PostgreSQL, Edge Functions, Authentication).
- Payments are processed securely via the PayPal API with server-side Supabase Webhooks for instant premium activation.
- GDPR compliant. Customer data is collected with explicit opt-in and stored securely on EU-based servers.
- Global accessibility: The application supports dynamic localized translations (FR, EN, ES, DE, ZH, etc.) via hreflang tags to serve the correct language based on the URL path.
